Merging is never a touch. How touches are counted

How touches are counted

The rate counts workload runs with a retained record that ended in the covered interval. Each run counts once. Bars assign it to its first successful human intervention; later interventions remain in history. Jobs stopped before starting are separate. Reads, sandbox opens, automatic starts and internal grouping jobs do not enter the touch count.
